        function clampFloatingBadgeToViewport() {
            const badge = document.getElementById('floatingClockBadge');
            if (!badge || !floatingBadgeHasCustomPos) return;
            const margin = 10;
            const rect = badge.getBoundingClientRect();
            const width = rect.width || badge.offsetWidth || 120;
            const height = rect.height || badge.offsetHeight || 56;

            let left = parseFloat(badge.style.left);
            let top = parseFloat(badge.style.top);
            if (Number.isNaN(left) || Number.isNaN(top)) return;

            const maxLeft = Math.max(margin, window.innerWidth - width - margin);
            const maxTop = Math.max(margin, window.innerHeight - height - margin);

            left = Math.min(Math.max(margin, left), maxLeft);
            top = Math.min(Math.max(margin, top), maxTop);

            badge.style.left = `${left}px`;
            badge.style.top = `${top}px`;
        }

        function initDraggableFloatingClock() {
            const badge = document.getElementById('floatingClockBadge');
            if (!badge) return;

            let isPointerDown = false;
            let startX = 0;
            let startY = 0;
            let origLeft = 0;
            let origTop = 0;

            badge.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
                if (e.button !== undefined && e.button !== 0 && e.pointerType === 'mouse') return;
                isPointerDown = true;
                floatingBadgeDragged = false;
                startX = e.clientX;
                startY = e.clientY;

                const rect = badge.getBoundingClientRect();
                origLeft = rect.left;
                origTop = rect.top;

                if (!floatingBadgeHasCustomPos) {
                    badge.style.right = 'auto';
                    badge.style.bottom = 'auto';
                    badge.style.left = `${origLeft}px`;
                    badge.style.top = `${origTop}px`;
                    floatingBadgeHasCustomPos = true;
                }

                badge.classList.add('is-dragging');

                try {
                    badge.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
                } catch (err) {}
            });

            badge.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
                if (!isPointerDown) return;
                const dx = e.clientX - startX;
                const dy = e.clientY - startY;

                if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 6) {
                    floatingBadgeDragged = true;
                }

                if (!floatingBadgeDragged) return;

                const margin = 10;
                const width = badge.offsetWidth || 120;
                const height = badge.offsetHeight || 56;
                const maxLeft = Math.max(margin, window.innerWidth - width - margin);
                const maxTop = Math.max(margin, window.innerHeight - height - margin);

                const nextLeft = Math.min(Math.max(margin, origLeft + dx), maxLeft);
                const nextTop = Math.min(Math.max(margin, origTop + dy), maxTop);

                badge.style.left = `${nextLeft}px`;
                badge.style.top = `${nextTop}px`;
            });

            const finishDrag = (e) => {
                if (!isPointerDown) return;
                isPointerDown = false;
                badge.classList.remove('is-dragging');
                try {
                    if (badge.hasPointerCapture && badge.hasPointerCapture(e.pointerId)) {
                        badge.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
                    }
                } catch (err) {}
                if (floatingBadgeDragged) {
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        floatingBadgeDragged = false;
                    }, 40);
                }
            };

            badge.addEventListener('pointerup', finishDrag);
            badge.addEventListener('pointercancel', finishDrag);
            window.addEventListener('resize', clampFloatingBadgeToViewport, { passive: true });
        }

            if (parts.length !== 3) return '';

            const daysProper = ['الأحد', 'الإثنين', 'الثلاثاء', 'الأربعاء', 'الخميس', 'الجمعة', 'السبت'];
            return daysProper[dt.getDay()] || '';

        function initCloudSync() {
            const cloudStatus = document.getElementById('cloudStatus');

            db.collection("daily_lessons").onSnapshot((snapshot) => {
                dailyLessonsData = {};
                snapshot.forEach(doc => {
                    dailyLessonsData[doc.id] = doc.data();
                });
                renderDailyLessonCards();
            }, (error) => {
                console.error("Daily lessons fetch error:", error);
            });

            db.collection("attendance_groups").doc("list").onSnapshot((doc) => {
                if (doc.exists && doc.data().groups && doc.data().groups.length > 0) {
                    groups = doc.data().groups.map(g => g.trim());
                } else {
                    groups = ['أول - أول', 'أول - ثاني', 'ثاني - أول'];
                    db.collection("attendance_groups").doc("list").set({ groups: groups });
                }
                updateGroupDropdowns();
            }, (error) => {
                console.error("Groups fetch error:", error);
                updateGroupDropdowns();
            });

            db.collection("allowed_students").onSnapshot((snapshot) => {
                allowedStudentsPreset = [];
                snapshot.forEach(doc => {
                    const data = doc.data();
                    if (data && data.name) {
                        allowedStudentsPreset.push(data.name.trim());
                    }
                });
                populatePresetDropdown();
            }, (error) => {
                console.error("Allowed students fetch error:", error);
            });

            db.collection("attendance_students").onSnapshot((snapshot) => {
                students = [];
                snapshot.forEach(doc => {
                    const data = doc.data();
                    students.push({
                        id: doc.id,
                        name: (data.name || "طالب بدون اسم").trim(),
                        email: getStudentEmail(data, doc.id),
                        group: (data.group || groups[0] || 'أول - أول').trim()
                    });
                });

                students.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'ar'));

                if (cloudStatus) cloudStatus.textContent = "متصل ومزامن";
                if (cloudIcon) cloudIcon.className = "fa-solid fa-cloud text-emerald-400";
                
                if (isStudentPortal && students.length > 0) {
                    const loader = document.getElementById('instantLoader');
                    if (loader) loader.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
                    renderStudentPortalView();
                }

                fetchAttendanceForDate(currentDate);
                fetchBehaviorsForDate(currentDate);
                checkAndRenderPendingCategory();
                refreshOpenCategoryModalIfActive();
            }, (error) => {
                console.error("Students fetch error:", error);
                if (cloudStatus) cloudStatus.textContent = "خطأ في الاتصال";
                if (cloudIcon) cloudIcon.className = "fa-solid fa-cloud text-rose-400";
            });

            db.collection("attendance_records").onSnapshot((snapshot) => {

        async function restoreAttendanceBackupJSON(event) {
            const file = event.target.files[0];
            if (!file) return;

            if (!confirm("هل أنت متأكد من استعادة هذه النسخة؟ سيتم دمج أو تحديث السجلات في السحابة بناءً على الملف.")) {
                event.target.value = '';
                return;
            }

            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = async function(e) {
                try {
                    showToast('جاري استعادة البيانات إلى السحابة...', 'cloud');
                    const backupData = JSON.parse(e.target.result);
                    let batch = db.batch();
                    let opCount = 0;

                    const commitIfNeeded = async () => {
                        if (opCount >= 400) {
                            await batch.commit();
                            batch = db.batch();
                            opCount = 0;
                        }
                    };

                    if (backupData.firestore && typeof backupData.firestore === "object") {
                        for (const [colName, docsObj] of Object.entries(backupData.firestore)) {
                            if (!docsObj || typeof docsObj !== "object") continue;
                            for (const [docId, docVal] of Object.entries(docsObj)) {
                                const ref = db.collection(colName).doc(docId);
                                batch.set(ref, docVal, { merge: true });
                                opCount++;
                                await commitIfNeeded();
                            }
                        }
                    } else {
                        if (backupData.attendance_records) {
                            for (const [dateKey, recordVal] of Object.entries(backupData.attendance_records)) {
                                const ref = db.collection("attendance_records").doc(dateKey);
                                batch.set(ref, recordVal, { merge: true });
                                opCount++;
                                await commitIfNeeded();
                            }
                        }

                        if (backupData.student_behaviors_records) {
                            for (const [dateKey, recordVal] of Object.entries(backupData.student_behaviors_records)) {
                                const ref = db.collection("student_behaviors_records").doc(dateKey);
                                batch.set(ref, recordVal, { merge: true });
                                opCount++;
                                await commitIfNeeded();
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if (opCount > 0) {
                        await batch.commit();
                    }

                    if (backupData.localStorage && typeof backupData.localStorage === "object") {
                        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(backupData.localStorage)) {
                            localStorage.setItem(k, v);
                        }
                    }

                    showToast('تمت الاستعادة بنجاح ☁️', 'success');
                    event.target.value = '';
                } catch (err) {
                    console.error("Restore backup error:", err);
                    showToast('ملف النسخة الاحتياطية غير صالح أو تالف', 'warning');
                    event.target.value = '';
                }
            };
            reader.readAsText(file);
        }

        function renderStudentPortalView() {
            const student = students.find(s => s.id === targetStudentId);
            if (!student) {
                document.getElementById('portalStudentName').textContent = "عذراً، الطالب غير موجود أو تم حذفه";
                return;
            }

            const groupPeers = students.filter(s => s.group === student.group).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'ar'));
            const studentNum = groupPeers.findIndex(s => s.id === student.id) + 1;

            document.getElementById('portalStudentName').textContent = `${studentNum > 0 ? '#' + studentNum + ' - ' : ''}${student.name}`;
            document.getElementById('portalStudentDetails').textContent = `الفصل: ${student.group} | البريد: ${student.email}`;

            let present = 0, absent = 0, late = 0, excused = 0;
            let homeworkDoneCount = 0, homeworkNotCount = 0, participationsCount = 0, behaviorsNotesCount = 0;
            let totalBehaviorScore = 0;
            const behaviorsContainer = document.getElementById('portalBehaviorsTableBody');
            behaviorsContainer.innerHTML = '';

            let hasBehaviors = false;
            const sortedDates = Object.keys(allAttendanceRecords).sort().reverse();
            const sortedBehaviorDates = Object.keys(allBehaviorsRecords).sort().reverse();

            sortedDates.forEach(date => {
                const dayRecords = allAttendanceRecords[date] || {};
                const recordObj = dayRecords[targetStudentId];
                if (recordObj) {
                    const st = typeof recordObj === 'object' && recordObj !== null ? recordObj.status : recordObj;
                    if (st === 'present') present++;
                    else if (st === 'absent') absent++;
                    else if (st === 'late') late++;
                    else if (st === 'excused') excused++;
                }
            });

            sortedBehaviorDates.forEach(date => {
                const dayBehaviorsList = (allBehaviorsRecords[date] || {})[targetStudentId] || [];
                dayBehaviorsList.forEach((item, itemIdx) => {
                    hasBehaviors = true;
                    totalBehaviorScore += Number(item.score || 0);

                    const name = item.name || '';
                    const isParticipation = name.includes('مشاركة') || name.includes('إجابة');
                    const isCustomNote = item.isCustomNote;

                    if (name.includes('حل الواجب') && !name.includes('لم يحل')) {
                        homeworkDoneCount++;
                    } else if (name.includes('لم يحل الواجب')) {
                        homeworkNotCount++;
                    } else if (isParticipation || (!name.includes('واجب') && !name.includes('ملف') && !name.includes('بحث') && !isCustomNote && item.score >= 0)) {
                        participationsCount++;
                    } else if (isCustomNote || item.score < 0) {
                        behaviorsNotesCount++;
                    }

                    let scoreBadgeClass = item.score > 0 ? "text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200" : (item.score < 0 ? "text-rose-600 bg-rose-50 border-rose-200" : "text-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50 border-indigo-200");
                    let pulseClass = (!isParticipation && !isCustomNote) ? " pulse-badge shadow-sm" : "";

                    const cardDiv = document.createElement('div');
                    cardDiv.className = 'p-4 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 transition rounded-xl border border-slate-200 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-3 shadow-sm';
                    cardDiv.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <span class="text-2xl">${item.icon}</span>
                            <div>
                                <h4 class="font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm">${escapeHtml(item.name)}</h4>
                                <p class="text-xs text-slate-500 font-mono mt-0.5">${getArabicDayNameFromStr(date)} ${date} | ⏰ ${item.time}</p>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-3 w-full sm:w-auto justify-between sm:justify-end">
                            <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-black border ${scoreBadgeClass}${pulseClass}">
                                ${item.score > 0 ? '+' + item.score : (item.score < 0 ? item.score : 'ملاحظة خطية')}
                            </span>
                            ${!isReadOnly ? `
                            <button onclick="removeBehaviorLogFromDate('${targetStudentId}', '${date}', ${itemIdx})" class="bg-rose-100 hover:bg-rose-200 text-rose-700 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm" title="حذف هذا السجل نهائياً">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can"></i> حذف
                            </button>` : ''}
                        </div>
                    `;
                    behaviorsContainer.appendChild(cardDiv);
                });
            });

            if (!hasBehaviors) {
                behaviorsContainer.innerHTML = `<div class="text-center p-8 text-slate-400 font-bold">لا توجد مشاركات أو ملاحظات مسجلة حتى الآن</div>`;
            }

            document.getElementById('portalPresent').textContent = present;
            document.getElementById('portalAbsent').textContent = absent;
            document.getElementById('portalLate').textContent = late;
            document.getElementById('portalExcused').textContent = excused;
            document.getElementById('portalHomeworkDone').textContent = homeworkDoneCount;
            document.getElementById('portalHomeworkNot').textContent = homeworkNotCount;
            document.getElementById('portalParticipations').textContent = participationsCount;
            document.getElementById('portalBehaviorsNotes').textContent = behaviorsNotesCount;
            document.getElementById('portalBehaviorPoints').textContent = totalBehaviorScore;

            const totalEval = present + absent + late;
            const rate = totalEval > 0 ? Math.round(((present + late) / totalEval) * 100) : 0;
            const rateBadge = document.getElementById('portalRateBadge');
            rateBadge.textContent = `${rate}%`;
            rateBadge.className = rate >= 75 ? "text-lg font-black text-emerald-600" : "text-lg font-black text-rose-600";
        }

        async function renameGroup(oldName) {
            const newName = prompt(`أدخل الاسم الجديد للفصل (${oldName}):`, oldName);
            if (!newName || newName.trim() === '' || newName.trim() === oldName) return;

            const trimmedNewName = newName.trim();
            if (groups.includes(trimmedNewName)) {
                showToast('يوجد فصل بنفس هذا الاسم بالفعل', 'warning');
                return;
            }

            groups = groups.map(g => g === oldName ? trimmedNewName : g);
            if (activeGroup === oldName) activeGroup = trimmedNewName;

            try {
                await db.collection("attendance_groups").doc("list").set({ groups: groups });
                const studentsToUpdate = students.filter(s => s.group === oldName);
                if (studentsToUpdate.length > 0) {
                    const batch = db.batch();
                    studentsToUpdate.forEach(student => {
                        const ref = db.collection("attendance_students").doc(student.id);
                        batch.update(ref, { group: trimmedNewName });
                    });
                    await batch.commit();
                }

                showToast(`تم تغيير اسم الفصل إلى (${trimmedNewName}) بنجاح ☁️`, 'cloud');
                updateGroupDropdowns();
                renderDailyLessonCards();
            } catch (err) {
                console.error("Rename group error:", err);
                showToast('حدث خطأ أثناء إعادة تسمية الفصل', 'warning');
            }
        }

        async function executeBatchAction() {
            if (isReadOnly) return;
            const targetDate = document.getElementById('batchActionDate').value;
            const selectVal = document.getElementById('batchActionSelect').value;

            if (!targetDate) {
                showToast('يرجى تحديد التاريخ أولاً', 'warning');
                return;
            }
            if (selectVal === "") {
                showToast('يرجى اختيار الحدث المراد رصده', 'warning');
                return;
            }

            const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="batchStudentCheckbox"]:checked');
            if (checkboxes.length === 0) {
                showToast('يرجى تحديد طالب واحد على الأقل', 'warning');
                return;
            }

            const action = defaultActions[parseInt(selectVal)];
            if (!action) return;

            let finalName = action.name;
            let isCustom = false;

            if (action.isCustomNote) {
                const customText = document.getElementById('batchCustomNoteInput').value.trim();
                if (!customText) {
                    showToast('يرجى كتابة نص الملاحظة الخطية أولاً', 'warning');
                    document.getElementById('batchCustomNoteInput').focus();
                    return;
                }
                finalName = customText;
                isCustom = true;
            }

            try {
                showToast('جاري الرصد الجماعي السحابي...', 'cloud');
                const docRef = db.collection("student_behaviors_records").doc(targetDate);
                const doc = await docRef.get();
                let dayBehaviors = doc.exists ? (doc.data().records || {}) : {};

                const now = new Date();
                const timeString = now.toLocaleTimeString('ar-SA', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

                checkboxes.forEach(cb => {
                    const studentId = cb.value;
                    if (!dayBehaviors[studentId]) {
                        dayBehaviors[studentId] = [];
                    }
                    const entry = {
                        icon: action.icon,
                        name: finalName,
                        score: action.score,
                        time: timeString
                    };
                    if (isCustom) entry.isCustomNote = true;
                    dayBehaviors[studentId].push(entry);
                });

                await docRef.set({
                    records: dayBehaviors,
                    updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
                }, { merge: true });

                showToast(`تم رصد (${finalName}) بنجاح لـ ${checkboxes.length} طالب سحابياً ☁️`, 'success');
                closeBatchActionModal();
            } catch (err) {
                console.error("Batch action error:", err);
                showToast('حدث خطأ أثناء الرصد الجماعي', 'warning');
            }
        }

        function renderSingleDayReport() {
            if (isStudentPortal || isUnifiedStudentLogin) return;
            updateSelectedDateLabels();
            const targetDate = currentDate;
            const dayRecords = allAttendanceRecords[targetDate] || {};

            let pCount = 0, aCount = 0, lCount = 0, oCount = 0;

            const filteredForReport = students.filter(s => {
                const sGroup = (s.group || '').trim();
                const actGroup = activeGroup.trim();
                return actGroup === 'الجميع' || sGroup === actGroup;
            });

            filteredForReport.forEach(s => {
                const recordObj = dayRecords[s.id];
                if (!recordObj) return;

                const status = typeof recordObj === 'object' && recordObj !== null ? recordObj.status : recordObj;
                if (status === 'present') pCount++;
                else if (status === 'absent') aCount++;
                else if (status === 'late') lCount++;
                else if (status === 'excused') oCount++;
            });

            document.getElementById('dayPresentCount').textContent = `${pCount} طالب`;
            document.getElementById('dayAbsentCount').textContent = `${aCount} طالب`;
            document.getElementById('dayLateCount').textContent = `${lCount} طالب`;
            document.getElementById('dayOtherCount').textContent = `${oCount} طالب`;

            let highAbsentTotal = 0;
            filteredForReport.forEach(student => {
                let absentCount = 0;
                Object.keys(allAttendanceRecords).forEach(date => {
                    const recordObj = (allAttendanceRecords[date] || {})[student.id];
                    const st = typeof recordObj === 'object' && recordObj !== null ? recordObj.status : recordObj;
                    if (st === 'absent') absentCount++;
                });
                if (absentCount >= 3) highAbsentTotal++;
            });
            document.getElementById('dayHighAbsentCount').textContent = `${highAbsentTotal} طالب`;

            let partCount = 0, hwDoneCount = 0, hwNotCount = 0, resCount = 0, forgotCount = 0, behCount = 0;

            filteredForReport.forEach(s => {
                Object.keys(allBehaviorsRecords).forEach(d => {
                    const logs = (allBehaviorsRecords[d] || {})[s.id] || [];
                    logs.forEach((item) => {
                        const name = item.name || '';
                        const isParticipation = name.includes('مشاركة') || name.includes('إجابة');
                        const isCustomNote = item.isCustomNote;

                        if (isParticipation && d !== targetDate) return;

                        if (name.includes('حل الواجب') && !name.includes('لم يحل')) {
                            hwDoneCount++;
                        } else if (name.includes('لم يحل الواجب')) {
                            hwNotCount++;
                        } else if (name.includes('إنجاز ملف') || name.includes('بحث')) {
                            resCount++;
                        } else if (name.includes('نسيان ملف')) {
                            forgotCount++;
                        } else if (isParticipation) {
                            partCount++;
                        } else if (item.score < 0 || isCustomNote) {
                            behCount++;
                        } else {
                            partCount++;
                        }
                    });
                });
            });

            document.getElementById('dayParticipationsCount').textContent = partCount;
            document.getElementById('dayHomeworkDoneCount').textContent = hwDoneCount;
            document.getElementById('dayHomeworkNotCount').textContent = hwNotCount;
            document.getElementById('dayResearchCount').textContent = resCount;
            const dayForgotCountEl = document.getElementById('dayForgotFileCount');
            if(dayForgotCountEl) dayForgotCountEl.textContent = forgotCount;
            document.getElementById('dayBehaviorsCount').textContent = behCount;
        }

        function exportCurrentModalCSV() {
            const targetDate = currentDate;
            const filteredStudents = students.filter(s => {
                const sGroup = (s.group || '').trim();
                const actGroup = activeGroup.trim();
                return actGroup === 'الجميع' || sGroup === actGroup;
            });

            let csvContent = "\uFEFF";
            let rowSeq = 0;
            if (currentModalCategory === 'present' || currentModalCategory === 'absent' || currentModalCategory === 'late' || currentModalCategory === 'excused' || currentModalCategory === 'other' || currentModalCategory === 'high_absent') {
                csvContent += `الرقم التسلسلي,اسم الطالب,البريد الإلكتروني,الفصل,الحالة/التفاصيل\n`;
                filteredStudents.forEach(student => {
                    const dayRecords = allAttendanceRecords[targetDate] || {};
                    const recordObj = dayRecords[student.id];
                    const status = typeof recordObj === 'object' && recordObj !== null ? recordObj.status : recordObj;
                    
                    let absentCount = 0;
                    Object.keys(allAttendanceRecords).forEach(d => {
                        const rec = (allAttendanceRecords[d] || {})[student.id];
                        const st = typeof rec === 'object' && rec !== null ? rec.status : rec;
                        if (st === 'absent') absentCount++;
                    });

                    let match = false;
                    if (currentModalCategory === 'present' && status === 'present') match = true;
                    if (currentModalCategory === 'absent' && status === 'absent') match = true;
                    if (currentModalCategory === 'late' && status === 'late') match = true;
                    if (currentModalCategory === 'excused' && status === 'excused') match = true;
                    if (currentModalCategory === 'other' && (status === 'late' || status === 'excused')) match = true;
                    if (currentModalCategory === 'high_absent' && absentCount >= 3) match = true;

                    if (match) {
                        rowSeq++;
                        csvContent += `"${rowSeq}","${student.name}","${student.email}","${student.group}","${currentModalCategory === 'high_absent' ? absentCount + ' أيام غياب' : status}"\n`;
                    }
                });
            } else {
                csvContent += `الرقم التسلسلي,اسم الطالب,البريد الإلكتروني,الفصل,السجل/المشاركة,الوقت\n`;
                filteredStudents.forEach(student => {
                    Object.keys(allBehaviorsRecords).forEach(d => {
                        const logs = (allBehaviorsRecords[d] || {})[student.id] || [];
                        logs.forEach(item => {
                            const name = item.name || '';
                            const isParticipation = name.includes('مشاركة') || name.includes('إجابة');
                            const isCustomNote = item.isCustomNote;
                            if (isParticipation && d !== targetDate) return;

                            let match = false;
                            if (currentModalCategory === 'participations' && (isParticipation || (!name.includes('واجب') && !name.includes('ملف') && !name.includes('بحث') && !isCustomNote && item.score >= 0))) match = true;
                            if (currentModalCategory === 'homework_done' && name.includes('حل الواجب') && !name.includes('لم يحل')) match = true;
                            if (currentModalCategory === 'homework_not' && name.includes('لم يحل الواجب')) match = true;
                            if (currentModalCategory === 'research' && (name.includes('إنجاز ملف') || name.includes('بحث'))) match = true;
                            if (currentModalCategory === 'forgot_file' && name.includes('نسيان ملف')) match = true;
                            if (currentModalCategory === 'behaviors' && (isCustomNote || (!isParticipation && item.score < 0))) match = true;

                            if (match) {
                                rowSeq++;
                                csvContent += `"${rowSeq}","${student.name}","${student.email}","${student.group}","${name.replace(/"/g, '""')}","${item.time}"\n`;
                            }
                        });
                    });
                });
            }

            const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
            const link = document.createElement("a");
            link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            link.download = `تقرير_${currentModalCategory}_${activeGroup}_${targetDate}.csv`;
            document.body.appendChild(link);
            link.click();
            document.body.removeChild(link);
        }

                            <div class="space-y-1">
                                ${!isReadOnly ? `
                                <select onchange="handleBehaviorDropdown('${student.id}', this)" class="w-full py-1.5 px-2.5 text-xs border border-indigo-200 rounded-xl bg-indigo-50/60 text-indigo-900 font-bold focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                    ${behaviorOptionsHTML}
                                </select>
                                ` : ''}
                                ${logsHTML}
                            </div>

                            <div class="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 flex justify-between items-center">
                                <a href="${studentPortalLink}" target="_blank" class="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-800 flex items-center gap-1">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-link"></i> ملف الطالب الفردي
                                </a>
                                ${!isReadOnly ? `
                                <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                                    <button onclick="openEditStudentModal('${student.id}')" class="text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-800 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition" title="تعديل اسم الطالب أو نقله لفصل آخر">
                                        <i class="fa-regular fa-pen-to-square"></i> تعديل
                                    </button>
                                    <button onclick="deleteStudent('${student.id}')" class="text-rose-500 hover:text-rose-700 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition" title="حذف الطالب">
                                        <i class="fa-regular fa-trash-can"></i> حذف
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                                ` : ''}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                };

                let rowHTML = buildStudentCardHTML(student1);
                if (student2) {
                    rowHTML += buildStudentCardHTML(student2);
                } else {
                    rowHTML += `<div></div>`;
                }

                rowDiv.innerHTML = rowHTML;
                studentsGridContainer.appendChild(rowDiv);
            }

            updateStats();
        }

        window.openEditStudentModal = function(studentId) {
            if (isReadOnly || isStudentPortal) return;
            const student = students.find(s => s.id === studentId);
            if (!student) return;

            currentEditingStudentId = studentId;
            document.getElementById('editStudentNameInput').value = student.name;

            const groupSelect = document.getElementById('editStudentGroupSelect');
            groupSelect.innerHTML = '';
            const availableGroups = groups.includes(student.group) ? groups : [student.group, ...groups];
            availableGroups.forEach(grp => {
                const opt = document.createElement('option');
                opt.value = grp;
                opt.textContent = grp;
                if (grp.trim() === student.group.trim()) opt.selected = true;
                groupSelect.appendChild(opt);
            });

            document.getElementById('editStudentModal').classList.remove('hidden');
            updateFloatingClockVisibility();
            setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('editStudentNameInput').focus(), 50);
        };

        window.closeEditStudentModal = function() {
            document.getElementById('editStudentModal').classList.add('hidden');
            currentEditingStudentId = null;
            updateFloatingClockVisibility();
        };

        window.saveStudentEdit = async function() {
            if (isReadOnly || isStudentPortal || !currentEditingStudentId) return;
            const student = students.find(s => s.id === currentEditingStudentId);
            if (!student) return;

            const newName = document.getElementById('editStudentNameInput').value.trim();
            const newGroup = document.getElementById('editStudentGroupSelect').value.trim();

            if (!newName) {
                showToast('يرجى إدخال اسم الطالب أولاً', 'warning');
                return;
            }
            if (!newGroup) {
                showToast('يرجى اختيار الفصل أولاً', 'warning');
                return;
            }

            const isDuplicate = students.some(s => s.id !== currentEditingStudentId && s.name === newName && s.group.trim() === newGroup);
            if (isDuplicate) {
                showToast('يوجد طالب بنفس هذا الاسم في الفصل المختار بالفعل', 'warning');
                return;
            }

            try {
                const groupChanged = student.group.trim() !== newGroup;
                await db.collection("attendance_students").doc(currentEditingStudentId).update({
                    name: newName,
                    group: newGroup
                });

                showToast(groupChanged ? `تم نقل (${newName}) إلى (${newGroup}) بكامل مدخلاته ☁️` : 'تم تعديل اسم الطالب بنجاح ☁️', 'cloud');
                closeEditStudentModal();
            } catch (error) {
                console.error("Error updating student:", error);
                showToast('حدث خطأ أثناء حفظ التعديل', 'warning');
            }
        };

        window.handleBehaviorDropdown = function(studentId, selectElement) {
            const val = selectElement.value;
            if (val === "") return;
            const actionIdx = parseInt(val);
            const action = defaultActions[actionIdx];
            selectElement.value = "";

            if (!action) return;

            if (action.isCustomNote) {
                openCustomNoteModal(studentId);
            } else {
                addBehaviorLog(studentId, action);
            }
        };

        function openCustomNoteModal(studentId) {
            currentCustomNoteStudentId = studentId;
            const student = students.find(s => s.id === studentId);
            const numMap = getStudentNumberMap();
            const stNum = numMap[studentId] ? `#${numMap[studentId]} - ` : '';
            document.getElementById('customNoteStudentName').textContent = `الطالب: ${stNum}${student ? student.name : ''}`;
            document.getElementById('customNoteInput').value = '';
            document.getElementById('customNoteModal').classList.remove('hidden');
            updateFloatingClockVisibility();
        }

        function closeCustomNoteModal() {
            document.getElementById('customNoteModal').classList.add('hidden');
            currentCustomNoteStudentId = null;
            updateFloatingClockVisibility();
        }

        async function saveCustomNote() {
            if (isReadOnly) return;
            const noteText = document.getElementById('customNoteInput').value.trim();
            if (!noteText || !currentCustomNoteStudentId) {
                showToast('يرجى كتابة نص الملاحظة أولاً', 'warning');
                return;
            }

            const now = new Date();
            const timeString = now.toLocaleTimeString('ar-SA', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
            const updatedBehaviors = { ...studentBehaviorsData };
            if (!updatedBehaviors[currentCustomNoteStudentId]) {
                updatedBehaviors[currentCustomNoteStudentId] = [];
            }

            updatedBehaviors[currentCustomNoteStudentId].push({
                icon: '📝',
                name: noteText,
                score: 0,
                time: timeString,
                isCustomNote: true
            });

            try {
                await db.collection("student_behaviors_records").doc(currentDate).set({
                    records: updatedBehaviors,
                    updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
                }, { merge: true });

                showToast('تم حفظ الملاحظة الخطية بنجاح ☁️', 'cloud');
                closeCustomNoteModal();
            } catch (error) {
                console.error("Error saving custom note:", error);
                showToast('فشل الحفظ السحابي', 'warning');
            }
        }

        async function addBehaviorLog(studentId, action) {
            if (isReadOnly || isStudentPortal) return;
            const now = new Date();
            const timeString = now.toLocaleTimeString('ar-SA', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
            const updatedBehaviors = { ...studentBehaviorsData };
            if (!updatedBehaviors[studentId]) {
                updatedBehaviors[studentId] = [];
            }

            updatedBehaviors[studentId].push({
                icon: action.icon,
                name: action.name,
                score: action.score,
                time: timeString
            });

            try {
                await db.collection("student_behaviors_records").doc(currentDate).set({
                    records: updatedBehaviors,
                    updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
                }, { merge: true });

                showToast(`تم تسجيل (${action.name}) للطالب بنجاح ☁️`, 'cloud');
            } catch (error) {
                console.error("Error saving behavior:", error);
                showToast('فشل الحفظ السحابي', 'warning');
            }
        }

        window.setStatus = async function(studentId, status) {
            if (isReadOnly || isStudentPortal) return;
            const updatedRecords = { ...attendanceData };

            if (status === 'unmarked' || status === '') {
                delete updatedRecords[studentId];
            } else {
                const now = new Date();
                const timeString = now.toLocaleTimeString('ar-SA', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
                updatedRecords[studentId] = {
                    status: status,
                    time: timeString
                };
            }

            try {
                await db.collection("attendance_records").doc(currentDate).set({
                    records: updatedRecords,
                    updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
                }, { merge: true });

                showToast('تم حفظ الحالة والوقت سحابياً ☁️', 'cloud');
            } catch (error) {
                console.error("Error saving status:", error);
                showToast('فشل الحفظ السحابي', 'warning');
            }
        };

        window.removeBehaviorLogFromDate = async function(studentId, dateStr, logIndex) {
            if (isReadOnly) return;
            try {
                const docRef = db.collection("student_behaviors_records").doc(dateStr);
                const doc = await docRef.get();
                if (!doc.exists) return;

                let targetDateBehaviors = doc.data().records || {};
                let studentLogs = targetDateBehaviors[studentId] || [];
                if (studentLogs.length <= logIndex) return;

                studentLogs.splice(logIndex, 1);
                if (studentLogs.length === 0) {
                    delete targetDateBehaviors[studentId];
                } else {
                    targetDateBehaviors[studentId] = studentLogs;
                }

                await docRef.set({
                    records: targetDateBehaviors,
                    updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
                });

                if (allBehaviorsRecords[dateStr]) {
                    if (studentLogs.length === 0) {
                        delete allBehaviorsRecords[dateStr][studentId];
                    } else {
                        allBehaviorsRecords[dateStr][studentId] = studentLogs;
                    }
                }

                if (isStudentPortal) {
                    renderStudentPortalView();
                } else {
                    renderTable();
                    refreshOpenCategoryModalIfActive();
                }

                showToast('تم حذف السجل بنجاح ☁️', 'info');
            } catch (error) {
                console.error("Error removing behavior:", error);
                showToast('فشل الحذف من السحابة', 'warning');
            }
        };

        window.deleteStudent = async function(studentId) {
            if (isReadOnly || isStudentPortal) return;
            if (!confirm("هل أنت متأكد من حذف الطالب من سجل السحابة؟")) return;

            try {
                await db.collection("attendance_students").doc(studentId).delete();
                showToast('تم حذف الطالب من السحابة', 'info');
            } catch (error) {
                console.error("Error deleting student:", error);
                showToast('حدث خطأ أثناء الحذف', 'warning');
            }
        };

        function updateStats() {
            if (isStudentPortal || isUnifiedStudentLogin) return;
            const activeStudents = students.filter(s => {
                const sGroup = (s.group || '').trim();
                const actGroup = activeGroup.trim();
                return actGroup === 'الجميع' || sGroup === actGroup;
            });

            const totalEl = document.getElementById('statTotal');
            if (totalEl) totalEl.textContent = activeStudents.length;
        }

        function setupEventListeners() {
            if (isStudentPortal || isUnifiedStudentLogin) return;
            selectedDateInput.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                currentDate = e.target.value;
                updateSelectedDateLabels();
                renderDailyLessonCards();
                fetchAttendanceForDate(currentDate);
                fetchBehaviorsForDate(currentDate);
                renderSingleDayReport();
            });

            document.getElementById('todayBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
                currentDate = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
                selectedDateInput.value = currentDate;
                updateSelectedDateLabels();
                renderDailyLessonCards();
                fetchAttendanceForDate(currentDate);
                fetchBehaviorsForDate(currentDate);
                renderSingleDayReport();
            });

            searchInput.addEventListener('input', renderTable);

            async function addStudentFromInput() {
                if (isReadOnly) return;
                const name = quickStudentInput.value.trim();
                if (!name) {
                    showToast('يرجى اختيار أو كتابة اسم الطالب أولاً', 'warning');
                    return;
                }

                const targetGroup = activeGroup === 'الجميع' ? (groups[0] || 'عام') : activeGroup;
                if (students.some(s => s.name === name && s.group.trim() === targetGroup.trim())) {
                    showToast('الطالب موجود مسبقاً في هذا الفصل', 'warning');
                    quickStudentInput.value = '';
                    return;
                }

                try {
                    await db.collection("attendance_students").add({
                        name: name,
                        email: "s" + Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000) + "@rb.moe.gov.sa",
                        group: targetGroup.trim(),
                        createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
                    });
                    showToast(`تم إضافة ${name} إلى (${targetGroup})`, 'success');
                    quickStudentInput.value = '';
                } catch (err) {
                    showToast('حدث خطأ في الإضافة للسحابة', 'warning');
                }
            }

            addQuickStudentBtn.addEventListener('click', addStudentFromInput);
            quickStudentInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    addStudentFromInput();
                }
            });

            const closeModal = () => {
                addModal.classList.add('hidden');
                updateFloatingClockVisibility();
            };
            document.getElementById('closeModalBtn').addEventListener('click', closeModal);
            document.getElementById('cancelModalBtn').addEventListener('click', closeModal);

            document.getElementById('saveNamesBtn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
                if (isReadOnly) return;
                const rawText = bulkNamesInput.value.trim();
                const selectedGroup = modalGroupSelector.value.trim();
                const lines = rawText ? rawText.split('\n').map(line => line.trim()).filter(line => line.length > 0) : [];

                if (!selectedGroup) {
                    showToast('يرجى تحديد الفصل أولاً', 'warning');
                    return;
                }

                try {
                    const batch = db.batch();
                    for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
                        let line1 = lines[i];
                        let line2 = lines[i+1];
                        let name = "", email = "";
                        if (line2 && line2.includes('@')) {
                            name = line1.replace(/@\S+/g, '').trim();
                            email = line2.trim().toLowerCase();
                            i++;
                        } else {
                            if (line1.includes('@')) {
                                let parts = line1.split(/\s+/);
                                email = parts.find(p => p.includes('@')) || '';
                                name = parts.filter(p => !p.includes('@')).join(' ');
                            } else {
                                name = line1;
                                email = `s${Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000)}@rb.moe.gov.sa`;
                            }
                        }

                        if (name) {
                            const exists = students.some(s => s.name === name && s.group.trim() === selectedGroup);
                            if (!exists) {
                                const newDocRef = db.collection("attendance_students").doc();
                                batch.set(newDocRef, {
                                    name: name,
                                    email: email,
                                    group: selectedGroup,
                                    createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    await batch.commit();
                    showToast(`تم حفظ الأسماء والإيميلات في فصل (${selectedGroup}) بالسحابة! ☁️`, 'cloud');
                    closeModal();
                } catch (err) {
                    console.error("Batch save error:", err);
                    showToast('حدث خطأ أثناء حفظ الأسماء', 'warning');
                }
            });
        }

        function exportToCSV() {
            const numMap = getStudentNumberMap();
            const activeStudents = students.filter(s => {
                const sGroup = (s.group || '').trim();
                const actGroup = activeGroup.trim();
                return actGroup === 'الجميع' || sGroup === actGroup;
            });

            if (activeStudents.length === 0) {
                showToast('لا توجد بيانات للتصدير!', 'warning');
                return;
            }

            let csvContent = "\uFEFF"; 
            csvContent += `الرقم,اسم الطالب,البريد الإلكتروني,الفصل/المجموعة,حالة الحضور ووقت الرصد\n`;

            activeStudents.forEach(student => {
                const recordObj = attendanceData[student.id];
                const status = typeof recordObj === 'object' && recordObj !== null ? recordObj.status : (recordObj || 'غير محدد');
                const timeStr = typeof recordObj === 'object' && recordObj !== null ? recordObj.time : '';

                let translatedStatus = 'غير محدد';
                if (status === 'present') translatedStatus = `حاضر (${timeStr})`;
                if (status === 'absent') translatedStatus = `غائب (${timeStr})`;
                if (status === 'late') translatedStatus = `متأخر (${timeStr})`;
                if (status === 'excused') translatedStatus = `بعذر (${timeStr})`;

                csvContent += `"${numMap[student.id] || ''}","${student.name.replace(/"/g, '""')}","${student.email}","${student.group}","${translatedStatus}"\n`;
            });

            const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
            const link = document.createElement("a");
            link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            link.download = `كشف_حضور_${activeGroup}_${currentDate}.csv`;
            document.body.appendChild(link);
            link.click();
            document.body.removeChild(link);
        }

        function shareReportWithManager() {
            updateShareUrl();
            document.getElementById('shareModal').classList.remove('hidden');
            updateFloatingClockVisibility();
        }

        function closeShareModal() {
            document.getElementById('shareModal').classList.add('hidden');
            updateFloatingClockVisibility();
        }

        function copyShareUrl() {
            const shareInput = document.getElementById('shareUrlInput');
            shareInput.select();
            document.execCommand('copy');
            showToast('تم نسخ رابط لوحة المدير بنجاح 📋', 'success');
        }

        function sendReportToWhatsAppManager() {
            const shareUrl = document.getElementById('shareUrlInput').value;
            const rawMessage = `سعادة مدير المدرسة المحترم،\n\nيمكنكم الاطلاع على لوحة المتابعة الكاملة للفصل: (${activeGroup}) عبر الرابط:\n${shareUrl}\n\nإعداد المعلم: أ/ عبدالعزيز الفيفي (ثانوية الأمير عبدالمجيد)`;
            window.open(`https://api.whatsapp.com/send?text=${encodeURIComponent(rawMessage)}`, '_blank');
        }

        function showToast(message, type = 'success') {
            const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
            const toastText = document.getElementById('toastText');
            const toastIcon = document.getElementById('toastIcon');
            toastText.textContent = message;

            if (type === 'cloud') {
                toastIcon.className = 'fa-solid fa-cloud-arrow-up text-indigo-400';
            } else if (type === 'warning') {
                toastIcon.className = 'fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation text-amber-400';
            } else {
                toastIcon.className = 'fa-solid fa-circle-check text-emerald-400';
            }

            toast.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none', 'translate-y-2');
            toast.classList.add('opacity-100', 'translate-y-0');

            setTimeout(() => {
                toast.classList.add('opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none', 'translate-y-2');
                toast.classList.remove('opacity-100', 'translate-y-0');
            }, 2500);
        }

        function escapeHtml(str) {
            return String(str).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(m) {
                for (let k in { '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"', "'": ''' }) {
                    if (k === m) return { '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"', "'": ''' }[m];
                }
                return m;
            });
        }
    </script>
